question: Where must the seed-syllable be written to complete this diagram of Great Gaṇapati?
premises: A seed-syllable is to be written.
It must be placed at the beginning and end.
This belongs to the diagram of Great Gaṇapati.
inference: The seed-syllable should be written at the beginning and end of this diagram of Great Gaṇapati.
uncertainties: Which specific seed-syllable is intended is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: And the seed-syllable should be written at the beginning and end; this is the diagram of Great Gaṇapati.
